children.role_hint: Main single-ended OTA signal-path core. M1/M0 form the NMOS differential input pair, M4/M3 form the complementary PMOS differential input pair, M5 provides PMOS tail/current-source bias from ib_sink, and M2 provides an NMOS self-bias/tail device controlled by the internal node net2. The output is taken at vo while net2 is the internal opposite-side branch and local bias/control node.

children.netlist:
.subckt complementary_input_single_ended_ota_core gnd ib_sink vdd vin vip vo
M2 net1 net2 gnd gnd nch l=ln_tail w=wn_tail m=1 nf=1
M1 vo vin net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M0 net2 vip net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M5 net3 ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1

M3 net2 vip net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
